protocol.candidates: Original suffix first, five root-posterior success-arrival quantile nominal routes, then V10 fixed-primary rescue if contiguous from this boundary; deduplicate in that order.
protocol.menu: Full public connection menu. Quantile routes exclude the incoming trip; root posterior means for every other trip. No actual arrival or held-out future event enters generation.
protocol.policy: Commit the maximum initial same-trip block. On successful arrival choose the frozen tail with minimum conditional expected upper; any prefix or selected-tail failure is deadline capped.
protocol.thresholds: All first post-boundary attempts use frozen nominal waiting thresholds (first_action_now=False), including the original suffix.
protocol.static_control: Minimum integrated upper over the exact same frozen tail family, before observing boundary arrival.
protocol.off_grid: Use original suffix, candidate zero, if an observed arrival is absent from the frozen finite-grid phase table.
protocol.pilot: First declared root is the pilot and is retained as its result. Stop before later roots if candidate generation or phase evaluation exceeds 120 seconds. Stop before evaluation if phase count times family exceeds 2000; preserve the partial receipt.
protocol.scope: Exact finite-grid feasible-policy diagnostic, not a whole-journey platform performance comparison or proof of true causal regret.
